name: Altay
author: semihakin803@gmail.com
description: Lightweight, OOP based Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server software written in PHP. Bedrock speaks UDP, so the primary allocation must be a UDP port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Fetches the server and a PHP build able to run it.

apt-get update --quiet
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

CHANNEL="${BUILD_TYPE:-stable}"
if [ "$CHANNEL" != "stable" ] && [ "$CHANNEL" != "nightly" ]; then
	echo "Unknown build type '$CHANNEL', falling back to stable."
	CHANNEL="stable"
fi

echo "Installing Altay from the $CHANNEL channel."

# -r because the install container runs as root, which the installer otherwise
# refuses: running a game server as root is a bad idea, but this step only
# writes files, and the server itself runs unprivileged.
curl -sL https://getaltay.org/download | bash -s - -r -v "$CHANNEL"

if [ ! -s Altay.phar ]; then
	echo "Install failed: Altay.phar was not written."
	exit 1
fi

curl -sL -o start.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/altayofficial/Altay-Eggs/master/start.sh
chmod +x start.sh

echo "Installed."

variables.name: Build type
variables.description: stable for the newest release, nightly for a build from the current master. Nightly builds carry no release notes and are not meant for a server people play on.
